package.description: A desktop app for recording time while working within or outside Azure DevOps.

en-US.description: A desktop app for recording time while working within or outside Azure DevOps.
en-US.longDescription: 7pace Timetracker lets users find and track Azure DevOps work items, switch between recent tasks, and automatically stop tracking when they leave or lock their computer.
en-US.name: 7pace Timetracker
